needsHuman.podium: Name the three managers the card shows. Lead with the manager, never the team name — a team name is user input. Say what it took to win the round, not the score the card already carries.
needsHuman.topPlayers: The card already lists the names and the points. Add what is not on it: what those players had in common this round, or who is about to face whom.
needsHuman.playerOfRound: The card carries his name, club and points. Add the stake — what he does to a squad that has him, or who he faces next.
needsHuman.teamOfWeek: Eleven names are already on the card. Add the one thing that is not: what the shape says about the round.
